about_the_game:
This game is the demo version of Seen Before. Some of the anomalies from the full version are included in this version. This is only a trial version.



Add it to your wishlist to get notified when the demo is released.

You're in a place you think you know. Everything feels familiar... but nothing seems to be where it should be.
The silence is deeply familiar. The walls feel like they’re watching you.
You’re not even sure if time is passing.
But what if you’re the one who’s different?
With every step, reality bends a little more. With every glance, the doubt deepens.
This place knows you.
But do you truly know it?

Step into an intense and mind-twisting psychological thriller experience.
You are alone in an environment filled with liminal spaces, dark corners, and nightmare-like loops.

Carefully examine your surroundings and determine if there are any anomalies.

Each spatial loop may be a copy of a place you thought you had seen before... but even a small detail can change everything.

If it's safe, return. If not... run immediately! Or maybe... it's already too late?

FEATURES:

  • Atmospheric sound and visual design inspired by liminal spaces.

  • A tension-filled experience supported by atmospheric sound design and visual details.

  • 30+ anomalies.

  • Tension arises where your awareness is tested.

Sounds familiar, doesn't it?

Maybe you've been here before.

Maybe you never left...
